intro: The Verge Personal Locker offers cutting-edge biometric security and added peace of mind with features like a built-in alarm, USB charging, and emergency access—combining elegance with functionality.

features.title: Biometric locking mechanism
features.text: Unlock with your fingerprint, effortlessly. Secure access is ensured, storing up to 20 unique fingerprints for quick, personal, and highly secure entry to your valuables.

features.title: External USB charging support
features.text: Never worry about battery power again. The external USB charging port lets you easily recharge your locker, ensuring that your security is always powered up and ready.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override
features.text: In case of low battery or forgotten credentials, the emergency mechanical override key ensures you never lose access to your most important belongings. Your security, your control.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze function
features.text: Stay secure even in emergencies. After multiple incorrect attempts, the keypad locks, preventing unauthorized access, keeping your valuables safe with peace of mind.

features.title: Robust cable lock
features.text: Add an extra layer of protection. The robust cable lock allows you to securely anchor your locker, preventing removal or tampering for superior security.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Verge Pl 2 Litres Steel Biometric Home Locker
